codexview.loading.note: Loading message while the list of rituals and customs loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

codexview.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title: what the Codex collects

codexview.title.note: Page title: the catalogue of rituals, customs and supernatural mechanics found in the text

codexview.discovered.note: Next to the page title: how many systems (rituals, customs…) have been found so far

codexview.verified_count.note: Next to the page title: how many of the systems the reviewer has approved

codexview.category.liturgical_ritual.note: Category of a system: a liturgical rite such as a sacrifice; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.supernatural_act.note: Category of a system: a supernatural act such as fire from heaven; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.legal_custom.note: Category of a system: a legal custom such as levirate marriage; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.social_custom.note: Category of a system: a social custom such as hospitality; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.prophetic_oracle.note: Category of a system: a prophetic oracle; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.theophany.note: Category of a system: an appearance of God; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.category.military_protocol.note: Category of a system: a military protocol; shown in capitals on a card

codexview.first_seen.note: Where a system first occurs; {verse} is a reference such as 1KGS.18.36, or a dash

codexview.verified.note: Mark on a card whose system the reviewer has approved; a star follows it

codexview.how_it_works.note: Small heading over the rules of a ritual or custom

codexview.occurrences.note: Small heading over the list of places in the text where the system happens
